title_zh: MCP Python SDK 2.0：别把它当成一次改名升级
title_en: MCP Python SDK 2.0 Is Not Just a Rename
excerpt_zh: MCP Python SDK 2.0 不只是把 FastMCP 改名。这篇文章用打电话/寄明信片、办事窗口补材料这些生活化类比，讲清楚无状态请求、统一 Client、Resolve 多轮交互等关键变化，附四张图解，帮你在不踩坑的前提下走完迁移。
excerpt_en: MCP Python SDK 2.0 changes far more than class names. Using everyday analogies—phone calls versus postcards, a service counter asking for missing paperwork—this guide walks through stateless requests, the unified Client, and Resolve-based interactions, with four diagrams and a migration order designed to avoid silent failures.

title_zh: Claude Code 对齐 5 小时用量窗口：用 Scheduled Routines 预热 Opus 与 Sonnet
title_en: Align Claude Code's 5-Hour Usage Windows: Warm Up Opus and Sonnet with Scheduled Routines
excerpt_zh: 用 Claude Code 自带的 Scheduled cloud agents，在真正开工前用最小请求启动 5 小时窗口。包含 Opus/Sonnet 分池的实测限定、8 个任务的参考时间表、配置方法与四个真实踩坑。
excerpt_en: Use Claude Code's built-in Scheduled cloud agents to start five-hour windows with a minimal request before real work. Includes the observed Opus/Sonnet pool boundary, an eight-routine example schedule, setup steps, and four real-world gotchas.

title_zh: 代码不再是瓶颈，瓶颈换了个地方
title_en: Code Is No Longer the Bottleneck — It Just Moved
excerpt_zh: 读完 Claude 官方那篇《The AI-native SDLC playbook》，最扎心的一句话是：代码已经不是研发流程里最慢的一环了。AI 把「写代码」这块最短板焊长之后，瓶颈搬到了审批、测试、发布这些人力速度的环节。用大白话拆解 Plan/Design/Build/Test/Deploy/Maintain 六阶段怎么重做一遍，intent.md/spec.md/plan.md/CLAUDE.md 这些文件都是干什么用的，附一张我用 Figma MCP 画的六阶段闭环图，以及普通开发者今天就能抄的三件事。
excerpt_en: Reading Claude's official "The AI-native SDLC playbook," the line that stuck was: code is no longer the slowest step. Once AI sped up writing code, the bottleneck moved to approvals, testing, and release — the stages still running at human speed. A plain-language walkthrough of the six SDLC stages, what intent.md/spec.md/plan.md/CLAUDE.md actually do, a loop diagram, and three things any solo developer can borrow today.
_note_en: en.md 暂为中文占位，待精翻

title_zh: HTTP 状态码速查：401、403、404、500 到底哪里出错
title_en: HTTP Status Codes Quick Reference: What 401, 403, 404, and 500 Actually Mean
excerpt_zh: 给普通用户和 Vibe Coding 开发者的 HTTP 状态码速查表：先用第一位判断问题方向，再区分最常见的 400、401、403、404、429、500、502、503、504。附 2xx、3xx、4xx、5xx 常用码、非标准厂商码和一套可直接照做的排查顺序。
excerpt_en: A practical HTTP status-code reference for users and vibe coders: identify the problem family by the first digit, then distinguish common codes such as 400, 401, 403, 404, 429, 500, 502, 503, and 504. Includes useful 2xx–5xx codes, vendor-specific codes, and a repeatable debugging checklist.

title_zh: Codex CLI 滚轮只翻输入历史？一行恢复完整对话滚动
title_en: Codex CLI Mouse Wheel Cycles Input History? Restore Full Conversation Scrolling
excerpt_zh: 在 Ghostty 里想向上翻 Codex 的回答，滚轮却只会切换输入历史。原因不是鼠标坏了，而是 TUI 的备用屏幕模式。一条 --no-alt-screen 命令恢复终端原生 scrollback，附会话恢复、永久配置与撤销方法。
excerpt_en: In Ghostty, the mouse wheel may cycle Codex input history instead of scrolling the conversation. Use --no-alt-screen to restore native terminal scrollback, with steps for resuming, making it permanent, and undoing it.

title_zh: Codex 告别重复授权：config.toml 与命令规则完整教程
title_en: Stop Repeated Codex Approvals: Complete Config and Rules Guide
excerpt_zh: 只讲 Codex：从 config.toml 的审批与沙箱，到 writable_roots、项目 trust、default.rules、验证、回滚和可直接复制的配置提示词。
excerpt_en: Codex only: approvals, sandbox boundaries, writable roots, project trust, persistent command rules, validation, rollback, and a copy-ready prompt.

title_zh: Claude Code 告别重复点 Yes：settings.json 与 Hook 完整教程
title_en: Stop Clicking Yes in Claude Code: Complete Settings and Hooks Guide
excerpt_zh: 只讲 Claude Code：完整 settings.json、auto 与 allow/deny、fail-closed PreToolUse Hook、验证、回滚和可直接复制的配置提示词。
excerpt_en: Claude Code only: complete settings, auto and allow/deny rules, a fail-closed PreToolUse hook, validation, rollback, and a copy-ready prompt.

title_zh: 别再当 Yes 工程师：Codex 与 Claude Code 权限配置完全指南
title_en: Stop Being a Yes Engineer: Complete Permissions for Codex and Claude Code
excerpt_zh: 读文件点一次、跑测试点一次、装依赖再点一次——解决办法不是关掉全部权限，而是把活动范围、日常白名单和硬红线分成三层。本文基于我的真实配置，完整给出脱敏后的 Codex config.toml、prefix_rule、Claude Code settings.json、PreToolUse Hook、委派场景与验证回滚步骤。
excerpt_en: Reading, testing, installing — every step asks again. The answer is not disabling all safeguards, but separating operating boundaries, routine passes, and hard red lines. A complete sanitized setup with Codex config.toml, prefix rules, Claude settings, programmable hooks, delegated-agent mode, verification, and rollback.

title_zh: 一个月，106 亿 token
title_en: One Month, 10.6 Billion Tokens
excerpt_zh: 把 6 月的 Claude Code 账单拉出来一看：106 亿 token，相当于一万遍《红楼梦》。但先别惊叹——95% 是缓存读取的「注水」，真正的干货是 3,224 万输出，约 240 本长篇小说的体量。这份按模型上色的日历还会讲故事：Fable 5 疯狂的四天、没有缓存的 GPT-5.5 有多贵、以及看 token 账单只需要盯的三个数。附全月交互报告。
excerpt_en: I pulled my June Claude Code bill: 10.6 billion tokens — ten thousand readings of a classic novel. But hold the awe: 95% is cache reads. The real output is 32M tokens, roughly 240 novels' worth. The model-colored calendar tells stories too: Fable 5's wild four days, how expensive a cache-less world is, and the only three numbers worth reading on a token bill. Interactive report included.
_note_en: en.md 暂为中文占位，待精翻

title_zh: 让 Claude Code 接入飞书：人不在电脑前，也能用飞书遥控它持续干活
title_en: Drive Claude Code From Feishu: Keep It Working While You Are Away
excerpt_zh: 用飞书消息驱动本机已登录的 Claude Code：在任意项目里发任务、实时看进度、多轮续接，它遇到要决策的地方就问你、你回一句它接着干。走订阅不花 API 钱，长连接不要公网。含飞书自建应用逐步配置、那个折腾很久的「私聊死活不回」权限坑，以及完整可复制代码。
excerpt_en: Drive your locally logged-in Claude Code from Feishu: send tasks in any project, watch progress live, resume across turns; it asks you when it needs a decision and continues once you reply. Runs on your subscription (no API cost), long-connection needs no public IP. Includes step-by-step Feishu app setup, the p2p-permission gotcha that cost me hours, and full copy-paste code.
_note_en: en.md 暂为中文占位，待精翻

title_zh: 你的 Agent demo 很惊艳，一上线就拉胯
title_en: Your Agent Demo Dazzles. Production Falls Flat.
excerpt_zh: 有 PM 问我智能体编排怎么落地，说主流是 LangGraph、Dify、Coze。我先泼冷水：这三个根本不在一个赛道。从「编排到底是什么」讲到「90% 的 Agent 为什么死在 demo 到生产之间」，再到三层分类、可控性光谱、中国合规两道坎、和一张能直接用的选型表——附 2026-06-26 当天实查的 GitHub star 数。
excerpt_en: A PM asked me how to deploy agent orchestration, naming LangGraph, Dify, Coze as the mainstream. My first reaction: these three are not even in the same race. From what orchestration actually is, to why 90% of agents die between demo and production, to the three-tier map, the control-vs-autonomy spectrum, China's two compliance walls, and a selection table you can use today — with GitHub stars verified live on 2026-06-26.
_note_en: en.md 暂为中文占位，待精翻

title_zh: 为什么巨头总是两三家？（精简版）
title_en: Why Giants Come in Twos and Threes (Short)
excerpt_zh: 《三足何以鼎立》的 3000 字精简版：外卖、地图、可乐、运营商——几乎每个成熟行业背后都不多不少两到三家。三把钥匙（中庸 / 古诺均衡 / 进化论）+ 中国烟草「只有一家」的特例，快速读懂这条稳定律。
excerpt_en: The 3000-word short version of 'Why Three Legs Stand': almost every mature industry stands on two or three giants. Three keys (the Golden Mean, Cournot equilibrium, evolution) plus China's single-firm tobacco monopoly — the stability law, fast.
_note_en: en.md 暂为中文占位，待精翻

title_zh: 三足何以鼎立：从中庸之道看懂全世界的巨头格局
title_en: Why Three Legs Stand: The Golden Mean Behind Every Market Duopoly
excerpt_zh: 外卖、地图、运营商、三桶油、可乐、Visa、安卓苹果——你接触的几乎每个成熟行业，背后都不多不少站着两到三个巨头。这不是巧合，而是同时被中国哲学（中庸）、西方经济学（古诺均衡）、进化论（自然选择）共同验证的稳定律。而中国烟草「只有一家」的特例，恰恰是这套理论最锋利的印证。
excerpt_en: Food delivery, maps, telecom, oil, cola, Visa, iOS vs Android — almost every mature industry you touch is backed by exactly two or three giants. Not coincidence, but a law of stability verified at once by Chinese philosophy (the Golden Mean), Western economics (Cournot equilibrium), and evolution. And China's single-firm tobacco monopoly is its sharpest proof.
_note_en: en.md 暂为中文占位，待精翻

title_zh: 我把 Fable 5 用到提前下线
title_en: I Used Fable 5 Until It Went Dark — Ahead of Schedule
excerpt_zh: Fable 5 上线，说 22 号前算套餐额度。我订着最高档套餐、平时一周用不到六成，这次六个会话并排 + 多 agent 工作流往死里喂，三天多把周额度榨干。结果它没到 22 号就提前下线了。带截图的完整实录 + 一点想法：模型不是软件，是生鲜。
excerpt_en: Fable 5 arrived, on-plan until the 22nd. I'm on the top tier and normally can't spend 60% of a week — this time I ran six sessions plus multi-agent workflows and drained the weekly quota in three days. Then it went offline before the 22nd. The full illustrated log, plus a thought: a model isn't software, it's fresh produce.

title_zh: 门槛没有消失，只是搬了家
title_en: The Bar Didn't Drop. It Moved.
excerpt_zh: 过去难在执行：记语法、配环境、读报错。现在难的变成另外三件事——说清楚问题、拆清楚任务、判断结果对不对。同样用 AI，人和人的差距不是缩小了，是被放大了。
excerpt_en: The hard part used to be execution: syntax, environments, errors. Now it's three other things — stating the problem, breaking down the work, judging the result. Same AI, and the gap between people is being amplified, not shrunk.

title_zh: 零基础的「基础」，从来不是代码基础
title_en: The "Basics" Were Never About Code
excerpt_zh: 一个完全不会写代码的设计师，两天做出了团队真在用的内部工具。她只做了三件事：把痛点讲清楚、对每一版说「对」或「不对」、在关键决策点拍板。
excerpt_en: A designer who can't write a line of code shipped a tool her team actually uses — in two days. She did exactly three things: described the pain clearly, said "right" or "wrong" to each iteration, made the calls at decision points.

title_zh: 用户分层，按场景不按人
title_en: Segment by Scenario, Not by Person
excerpt_zh: 同一个人，写代码的时候是极客，处理法务的时候就是小白，写文案的时候又成了要求「指哪打哪」的专家。用户分层从来不该按人分，该按场景分。
excerpt_en: The same person is a geek when coding, a novice when facing legal paperwork, and an expert demanding pixel-level control when writing copy. Segmentation should never cut by person — it cuts by scenario.

title_zh: 提示词就是代码
title_en: Prompts Are Code
excerpt_zh: 提示词就是代码，只不过运行它的不是编译器，是模型。结构清楚的指令，误执行率就是低。你对提示词有多严谨，AI 就对你的需求有多严谨。
excerpt_en: Prompts are code — the runtime just happens to be a model, not a compiler. Well-structured instructions get misexecuted less. The rigor you put into your prompt is the rigor AI puts into your request.

title_zh: 断电之后还剩多少
title_en: What Survives a Power Cut
excerpt_zh: 网络会断，上下文会爆，任务会跑偏。把活拆成原子块，断在哪就能从哪续上。系统的好坏，不看顺风时跑多快，看断电后还剩多少。
excerpt_en: Networks drop, context overflows, tasks drift. Cut work into atomic blocks and you resume wherever it broke. Judge a system not by how fast it runs downwind, but by how much survives a power cut.

title_zh: 先做项目，再补知识
title_en: Build First, Learn Later
excerpt_zh: 传统路径是「学好了再做」，结果学员死在第三周的语法课里。现在我让他们第一节课就跑通一个能用的东西。不求一次全懂，求逐步打通。
excerpt_en: The traditional path is "learn properly, then build" — and students die in week three, somewhere in the syntax chapters. Now everyone gets something working in lesson one. Don't aim to understand it all at once; aim to break through, step by step.

title_zh: 语音输入的瓶颈，不在识别
title_en: The Bottleneck in Voice Input Isn't Recognition
excerpt_zh: 识别准确率从 93% 卷到 95%，没人愿意多花那 0.2 秒去润色。但用户要的从来不是「准」，是「我说一段话，出来一段能直接发出去的字」。
excerpt_en: Voice tools grind recognition from 93% to 95%; nobody spends the extra 0.2 seconds on polishing. But what users want has never been "accurate" — it's "I speak, and what comes out is something I can ship."

title_zh: Claude 账号登录问题 · 完整解决方案
title_en: Claude Login · Full Guide
excerpt_zh: 学员里十个有八个卡在登录这一步。这篇把所有可能的卡点和对应方案讲清楚。
excerpt_en: Most students get stuck at login. Every common failure point and the matching fix.

title_zh: Claude 登录常见问题 · FAQ
title_en: Claude Login · FAQ
excerpt_zh: 按报错现象查。找到一样的就照着做。
excerpt_en: Symptom-based troubleshooting list for Claude login & Claude Code.

title_zh: Typevoise 的最后一公里
title_en: Typevoise's Last Mile
excerpt_zh: 做 Typevoise 之前我以为难点是识别。后来发现真正的瓶颈在另一个地方。
excerpt_en: Before Typevoise I thought the hard part was recognition. The real bottleneck was somewhere else.

title_zh: AI 时代最危险的不是不会用
title_en: The Real Risk in the AI Era Isn't That You Don't Use It
excerpt_zh: 教零基础学员的时候我观察到三种「假装会用 AI」的姿势。哪一种都能让聪明人陷在原地。
excerpt_en: Teaching beginners, I noticed three postures of pretending to use AI. Any one of them can trap a smart person in place.

title_zh: 一门课的比喻预算
title_en: A Course's Metaphor Budget
excerpt_zh: 做课的人总想给每个概念配比喻。但学员的脑子里只有三个槽位。多了不是加分，是互相冲撞。
excerpt_en: Course designers want a metaphor for every concept. But students only have three slots. More than that, metaphors don't add — they collide.

title_zh: 为什么自建一个 Claude Code 中转网关
title_en: Why I Self-Host a Claude Code Gateway
excerpt_zh: 朋友问我为什么不直接订 Claude Pro。一开始我以为是为了省钱，做完之后才明白不是。
excerpt_en: A friend asked why I don't just subscribe to Claude Pro. I thought it was about money. Turns out it wasn't.
